meta.portal: https://bigdataprovince.nabc.go.th (NABC - National Agricultural Big Data Center, 'Big Data จังหวัด')
meta.label: NOT FOUND — no amphoe(district) x crop x planted/harvested-area/production/yield dataset exists behind this portal's public API
meta.route: Portal is an Angular SPA; all data is served from a same-origin, TOKEN-FREE, CORS-open REST API at https://bigdataprovince.nabc.go.th/api/v1/* (confirmed reachable with plain `requests`, no browser/session needed, no Cloudflare challenge on the API subpaths even though the page itself sits behind Cloudflare). Endpoint inventory was built two ways: (1) capturing every XHR fired by Playwright while loading the province dashboard (province_code=18 default), and (2) static-searching the three downloaded Angular JS bundles (main.*.js, 576.*.js /* polyfills+vendor */, 641.*.js /* the actual dashboard components+services, 2MB */) for `apiUrl+"..."` and `base_url}...` string-concat patterns, which surfaced additional routes never fired by the default page (e.g. data_bigplot_detail, data_agri_farmergroup_detail, data_agri_community_detail, data_agri_learning_detail, data_smart_farmer_detail, data_agri_volunteer_detail).
meta.verdict: The API cleanly separates GEOGRAPHY from CROP and never joins them below province level. (A) The only endpoint with true amphoe(district) grain for agriculture, `area_map/district-area-agri?province_code=&year=`, returns ONE crop-agnostic number per district (`agri_area`, total agricultural land) with no `product_name`/crop field at all — confirmed by reading the Angular component source (`loadDistrictAreaAgri()` in the compiled chunk): it maps `district -> agri_area` into a Map with zero crop dimension, feeding only a district ranking list / choropleth. (B) The only endpoint with real crop-level detail and the full requested field set — `production/all?province_code=` (fields: product_name, area_plant, area_harvest, production, yield_harvest, farmer, price_avg, cost) — is PROVINCE grain only, and is a sparse pilot: of 77 provinces probed, only 3 have ANY rows (ชัยนาท=18: 5 crop rows; บุรีรัมย์=31: 2 rows; สงขลา=90: 3 rows); the other 74 provinces 404 with 'ไม่พบข้อมูล สำหรับรหัสจังหวัดที่ระบุ' (no data for the given province code). This is clearly a portal still being populated, not a finished national data product. (C) The closest thing to a crop x geography join is `data_bigplot_detail` (the 'แปลงใหญ่'/collaborative-farm-plot program roster) — it has a real crop field (`product_name`) and `area` (rai) but NO structured district/amphoe field; the group name (`bigplot_name`) is free text that SOMETIMES embeds 'ตำบล...อำเภอ...' (e.g. 'กลุ่มเกษตรกรแปลงใหญ่ข้าว(กลุ่มจังหวัด) ตำบลชีวาน อำเภอพิมาย จังหวัดนครราชสีมา') and OFTEN does not (e.g. 'กลุ่มเกษตรกรทำสวนยางพาราโคราช' — no district mentioned). Regex-extracting a district from this free text would be unreliable (no validation set, inconsistent naming) and was deliberately NOT attempted — would be a fabricated/estimated field dressed up as measured, which this pipeline's provenance rule forbids. (D) Three OTHER endpoints (`data_agri_farmergroup_detail`, `data_agri_community_detail`, `data_agri_learning_detail`) DO have a clean `district_name` field at true amphoe grain (row count matches the province's actual amphoe count, e.g. 32 for นครราชสีมา, 25 for เชียงใหม่, 23 for นครศรีธรรมราช) but carry NO crop/production field — they are farmer-group/community/learning-center REGISTRIES (name, address, member count, activity `type` bucket like ทำนา/ทำสวน/ทำไร่/เลี้ยงสัตว์/ประมง/อื่นๆ), not yield or area data. Net: no combination of these endpoints reconstructs a real amphoe x crop x (planted/harvested/production/yield) row without inventing the join, so this file is intentionally left EMPTY rather than fabricated.

endpoints_probed.area_map/district-area-agri?province_cod: AMPHOE grain, crop-agnostic (total agri_area only). Full national coverage (77/77 provinces, 932 raw amphoe rows). Saved separately — see source-data/staging/nabc_amphoe_agri_area.json (NOT this file, since it has no crop dimension).
endpoints_probed.production/all?province_code=: PROVINCE grain, real crop detail (product_name, area_plant, area_harvest, production, yield_harvest, farmer, price_avg, cost). Sparse pilot: only 3/77 provinces populated (ชัยนาท, บุรีรัมย์, สงขลา). Raw saved per-province under source-data/raw/nabc-bigdata/production_all/.
endpoints_probed.data_bigplot_detail?province_id=&year=&l: Crop-tagged (product_name) 'แปลงใหญ่' collaborative-plot roster with area(rai) and member count, but NO structured district field. Sampled for the 3 requested provinces (2314 / 577 / 809 rows for นครราชสีมา / เชียงใหม่ / นครศรีธรรมราช). Raw saved under source-data/raw/nabc-bigdata/samples/.
endpoints_probed.data_agri_farmergroup_detail?province_id: AMPHOE grain (district_name), no crop field. Activity-type bucket (`type`) incl. livestock (เลี้ยงสัตว์) / fishery (ประมง) — the only trace of livestock/fishery in this API; no dedicated livestock dataset exists. Sampled for 3 provinces.
endpoints_probed.data_agri_community_detail?province_id=&: AMPHOE grain (district_name), farmer/agri-community registry (name, address, tel, member count), no crop field. Sampled for 3 provinces.
endpoints_probed.data_agri_learning_detail?province_id=&l: AMPHOE grain (district_name) PLUS lat/lon point coordinates (UTM x/y and WGS84 lat/lon) for each learning-center site — the only geocoded point layer found on this portal. No crop field beyond a free-text `type` (e.g. 'ศูนย์เรียนรู้ด้านข้าว/ศูนย์ข้าวชุมชน'). Sampled for 3 provinces.
endpoints_probed.data_smart_farmer_detail?province_id=: PROVINCE grain only (no district_name) — smart-farmer / young-smart-farmer / agri-biz counts.
endpoints_probed.data_agri_volunteer_detail?province_id=: PROVINCE grain only — 'ชาวนาอาสา' (volunteer farmer-liaison) counts.
endpoints_probed.agriecon/econsocio, agriecon/econgpp, ir: All PROVINCE grain (income/debt, GPP, irrigation area/wells/reservoirs/ponds/water-source counts, population, land-use, zoning S1/S2/S3/N). No amphoe breakdown on any of these.
endpoints_probed.masterprovince: 77 provinces, {province_code, province_name} — used to resolve all province_code params below.

meta.auth: NONE. Every /api/v1/* endpoint returned data to a bare `requests.get()` with only a generic User-Agent header — no API key, no cookies, no CORS preflight rejection, no Cloudflare bot-challenge on the API subpaths (the challenge scripts seen loading on the HTML page apparently gate only the page shell / are passive telemetry, not the JSON API). Matches the friendliness already observed for agriapi.nabc.go.th.
meta.rate_limiting_observed: None observed across ~250 sequential requests at ~0.08-0.15s spacing from this session; no 429s, no IP block.
parse_notes: This file's `rows` is intentionally empty (see `verdict`). Do not backfill it by mapping `district-area-agri`'s crop-agnostic `agri_area` into `planted_rai` — that would misrepresent a total-agri-land number as a crop-specific figure.

The genuinely useful amphoe-grain output of this investigation is source-data/staging/nabc_amphoe_agri_area.json (total district land area + total agri land area, all 77 provinces) — see that file's own meta.
Raw JSON for every probed endpoint (coverage sweeps + 3-province samples) is archived under source-data/raw/nabc-bigdata/ for reproducibility / re-audit.
